task_instance: Find the current Remotion documentation for the <Sequence> component by querying the Algolia search endpoint, then fetch the top result page as Markdown (by appending .md to its docs URL) so the current API can be read and implemented.
blocker_detail: The skill's entire deliverable is retrieving live documentation over the network: it requires an HTTP POST to a hosted Algolia search API and then fetching documentation pages from the Remotion docs website. In this skill copy, the search endpoint and every docs page address are replaced by unreachable placeholders ([url-1] through [url-4]), so there is no real host to query or fetch. This round's rules additionally forbid using any web fetch or web search tool and forbid opening links, so even a reachable endpoint could not be contacted. Fabricating or stubbing the search results or the Markdown pages is disallowed and would not be the real deliverable. With no shell and no code execution either, there is no alternative route to the live docs.
evidence: Read the SKILL.md at the skill path. Its Workflow requires: (1) POST a JSON query to the Algolia search API at [url-1] with indexName 'remotion'; (2) pick a result url; (3) fetch that url with a .md suffix ([url-2]..[url-4]); (4) implement from the fetched current docs. All four URLs are placeholders standing for resources that cannot be reached, and the runtime/round rules forbid web fetch/search and opening links, so no live search or page retrieval could be performed and no actual documentation deliverable could be produced or verified. No sample input data applies here since the skill operates only against the live remote docs service.
